name: com.realestate.smarthouse
description: Voice-controlled lights, wall switches, master switch, control panel, optional motion-sensor lighting and simulated energy monitor, and a five-speed ceiling fan with a wall regulator for houses generated by the Real Estate platform. Works from a .smarthouse.json data file next to the exported .glb. Not yet tested on a Meta Quest.

samples.description: The sample data file; add DemoHouseBuilder + SmartHouseController to try everything before importing a real model.
Loads a .glb from a URL or file at run time and binds the smart house to it. Needs the glTFast package.
